// ADR-291 §Decision 9 — orders rebuilt in the builder, generated by packages/shared/src/codeView/generate.ts.
// Golden output of apps/builder/src/preview/catalog/__tests__/adr291CodeView.test.tsx (UPDATE_CODE_VIEW=1 rewrites).

import {ListBox, ListBoxItem} from 'react-aria-components';
import JsonFormula from '@adobe/json-formula';
import ordersData from './data/orders';

export default function Home() {
  let formula = new JsonFormula();
  let computed = (item, fields) => ({...item, ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(fields).map(([key, field]) => [key, formula.search(field.formula, item)]))});
  let ordersFields = {
    total: {type: 'number', formula: 'price * qty'},
    total_text: {type: 'string', formula: 'price * qty'},
    items_sum: {type: 'number', formula: 'sum(items[*].price)'},
  };
  let orders = ordersData.map(item => computed(item, ordersFields));

  return (
    <>
      <ListBox items={orders}>
        {item => <ListBoxItem id={item.id} textValue={String(item.id)}>{item.id}</ListBoxItem>}
      </ListBox>
    </>
  );
}
